name: Paradisus Grand Cana
positioning: All-inclusive, all-suite family resort in Playa Bavaro, Punta Cana, officially called Paradisus Grand Cana - All Suites, with a water park, a kids' club and a private beach
best_for: Families with children and teens who want a water park and a supervised kids' program
Guests who want golf or tennis close to an all-inclusive resort

facts.text: The resort is an all-inclusive hotel located in Playa Bavaro, Punta Cana.
Sal is a modern steakhouse inspired by the work of Picasso, with a private room for celebrations.
Tori is an Asian fusion restaurant with a sushi bar, robatayaki and teppanyaki tables.
Lemon Fish is a Peruvian cevicheria serving ceviches, tiraditos, pokes and tartares.
Agua Marina by Leandro Diaz combines Caribbean flavors with contemporary cuisine in a beachfront setting.
Mama & Juana is a poolside cocktail bar with daily performances, named after the Dominican drink Mama Juana.
The Kidsdom kids' program is designed for young people between 1 and 16 years old, with experiences adapted to each age.
Family Concierge guests have a Destination Concierge available 24/7 for activity or restaurant bookings.
Swim-Up Suites have a private solarium with a whirlpool bathtub and direct access to the pool.
YHI Spa's services are certified by Wellness for Cancer.
The hotel is pet-friendly, with a program designed for dogs.
The hotel has a private beach.

highlights.text: Aquazone is the resort's water park, with slides and splash zones for kids and families.
Guests get free and unlimited access to the Fun Republic Entertainment Park.
The Cocotal Golf and Country Club is a 27-hole course designed by Pepe Gancedo.
The Rafa Nadal Tennis Center offers tennis and padel with coaches certified in the Rafa Nadal methodology.
Family Concierge guests can join a hands-on class to learn how to prepare mofongo with traditional local ingredients.

considerations.text: Perks such as the reserved beach area and private check-in and check-out are part of the Family Concierge service, not every suite.
Guests who want to bring a pet should contact the hotel to check conditions and manage the booking.
